# Choosing what to work on

## The effort and impact matrix

Sort every task on a two-by-two matrix of effort and impact. Quick wins take little effort and have high impact. Big bets take a lot of effort and have high impact. Fill-ins take little effort and have low impact. Time sinks take a lot of effort and have low impact.

## Designers and engineers

Designers own the research and the interface. Engineers own the architecture and the code. Both share responsibility for accessibility and for testing with real customers.

## Hosting the wiki

We compared hosting the wiki ourselves with paying for a managed service. Self-hosting costs less each month but needs an engineer to apply updates. The managed service costs more, whereas it includes backups and support.
